items.text: Structural AI demand is real and the 10+ trillion of AI capex that will be spent between now and 2030 will deliver companies like $NVDA and $MU remarkable earnings for the foreseeable future. We are at the point of the cycle where the trend and the demand can remain in tact but that has become completely irrelevant to how stocks behave. This is why we’ve seen indices go from ATH to year lows in less than 30 days. Great companies delivering great earnings can’t consistently overcome war, interest rates, inflation, policy, China, and other macro headwinds. The market is spooked, capital is nervous, and great companies are being sold. This won’t last forever. The same way everything can’t keep going up forever, the selling will slow, capitulation seems near. What a ride. 😐🙏🏻
